attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 35, `gmhB` to `dapD`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, 35 persistent and 1 shell, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls. The model names 94 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 35, `dapD`, 94%.

**A single variable column breaks the first spine**: column 36, `yaeI`, shell, carried by 55%, the least plastic stretch of the window. Columns 61 to 67, `yadN` to `yadC`, are [[fimbrial proteins]], carried by 27 to 57%, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 37 to 85%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 63%, and hesitates less there, 0.14 against 0.59 bits. It hesitates most at column 63, `htrE`, a variable column, 1.05 bits.

**The window ends on a spine.** Columns 68 to 78, `panB` to `gcd`, are carried by 91 to 96%, all persistent. The last column is `cueO`, in 85% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.20 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.97 against 0.12 bits, and names fewer genes, 39% against 98%.

label: gmhB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the gmhB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gmhB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,513 to 3,592 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gmhB once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,267 calls, named 99%, 0.10 bits; shell 5,455 calls, named 51%, 0.81 bits; cloud 238 calls, named 0%, 2.27 bits. Outside an RGP 38,895 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; inside an RGP 4,065 calls, named 39%, 0.97 bits. Columns: 70 spine, 4 fork, 6 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.97 against 0.12 bits) and names fewer genes (39% against 98%); 4,065 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 63 (htrE, a variable column) 1.05 bits, RGP 85%; column 61 (yadN, a fork column) 0.88 bits, RGP 84%; column 62 (yadV, a fork column) 0.88 bits, RGP 85%. The 6 columns (columns 61-66) where most calls are in an RGP: named 48%, 0.70 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 96%, 0.16 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 70 spine columns: named 96%, 0.14 bits on average; the 10 fork and variable columns: named 63%, 0.59 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 63, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 61-67 (fork and variable columns), RGP 37-85%; the least: column 36 (variable), RGP 1%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-35 (36 columns) spine: share 91-100%, 35 P, 1 S, RGP 0-3%. Genes: gmhB, metN, metI "methionine ABC transporter permease…", metQ, rcsF, tsaA, proS, yaeF "YaeF family permuted papain-like en…", nlpE, arfB, yaeQ "YaeQ family protein", yaeP "YaeP family protein", rof, tilS, yaeR "VOC family protein", ldcC, accA, dnaE, rnhB, lpxB "lipid-A-disaccharide synthase", lpxA, fabZ, lpxD, skp, bamA, rseP, cdsA, ispU "(2E,6E)-farnesyl-diphosphate-specif…", ispC, frr, pyrH, tsf, rpsB, map, glnD, dapD. named 94-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 35 (dapD), named 94%; most hesitant at column 15 (ldcC), 0.49 bits.
[S2] 2. column 36 variable: share 55%, all S, RGP 1%. named 84%; 0.62 bits.
[S2.c36]    36: yaeI S 55% "phosphodiesterase YaeI"
[S3] 3. columns 37-51 (15 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 2-4%. Genes: yaeH "DUF3461 family protein", cdaR, degP, dgt, mtnN, btuF, yadS "TRIC cation channel family protein", erpA, yadW "small protein YadW", clcA, yadX "protein YadX", hemL, fhuB "Fe(3+)-hydroxamate ABC transporter…", fhuD, fhuC. named 87-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 51 (fhuC), named 87%; most hesitant at column 47 (yadX), 0.33 bits.
[S4] 4. column 52 variable: share 78%, all S, RGP 4%. named 90%; 0.42 bits.
[S4.c52]    52: fhuA S 78%
[S5] 5. columns 53-60 (8 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 3-46%. Genes: mrcB, hrpB, thpR, sfsA, dksA, gluQRS, pcnB, folK. named 74-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 60 (folK), named 74%, 0.47 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 61-67 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: share 27-57%, all S, RGP 37-85%. named 26-77% (mean 52%), fewest named at column 64, named 26%; most hesitant at column 63, 1.05 bits.
[S6.c61]    61 fork: yadN S 57% "fimbrial protein"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 23%, yadV S 14%
[S6.c62]    62 fork: yadV S 57% "fimbrial chaperone"; also htrE S 13%
[S6.c63]    63 variable: htrE S 49%
[S6.c64]    64 variable: yadM S 35% "fimbrial protein"
[S6.c65]    65 variable: yadL S 35% "fimbrial-like protein YadL"
[S6.c66]    66 fork: yadK S 48% "fimbrial-like protein"; also "fimbrial-like adhesin" S 11%
[S6.c67]    67 variable: yadC S 27% "fimbrial tip-adhesin YadC"
[S7] 7. columns 68-78 (11 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 3-8%. Genes: panB, panC "pantoate--beta-alanine ligase", rpnC, panD, yadE "polysaccharide deacetylase family p…", yadI "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", yadH "ABC transporter permease", yadG "ABC transporter ATP-binding protein", can, hpt, gcd. named 86-97% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 68 (panB), named 86%; most hesitant at column 69 (panC), 0.43 bits.
[S8] 8. column 79 fork: share 85%, all P, RGP 5%. named 95%; 0.19 bits.
[S8.c79]    79: cueO P 85%; also yacC P 55%, speE P 27%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 1-3 (metN to metQ) [S1]: methionine, transporter; columns 49-52 (fhuB to fhuA) [S3, S4]: hydroxamate, transporter; columns 61-67 (yadN to yadC) [S6]: fimbrial; columns 73-75 (yadI to yadG) [S7]: transporter.
